source_units.text: Write a letter addressed to a future self.
The full text must be between 60 and 90 words.
Use this fictional material: The speaker is building an unfinished bench and worries about abandoning it.
Refer to one small promise to finish a useful thing, and close with keep making room.
Required wording, verbatim: "the unfinished bench", "one small promise", "keep making room".
Use wording suitable for myself opening the letter ten years later.
